description: SUMMEER – 24 June 2021 Surfside Building Collapse is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Juyeong Choi, Florida State University (fsu.edu). On June 24, 2021, a large portion of the Champlain Towers South 12-story apartment building partially collapsed. The collapse resulted in a total of 98 fatalities and 11 injuries. The structure was part of a complex of three buildings. Coverage: Surfside, Florida. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: SUMMEER, Virtual Reconnaissance, Structural Collapse, Construction and Demolition Debris, I-WASTE. Published 2023-05-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
